title: Proof technique
instruction: Separately, label which proof technique each answer used.

labels.name: direct
labels.description: a direct derivation from the hypotheses

labels.name: induction
labels.description: induction over a parameter, including strong induction

labels.name: contradiction
labels.description: assumes the negation and derives a contradiction

labels.name: construction
labels.description: exhibits an explicit witness or algorithm

labels.name: other
labels.description: an argument that fits none of the above

notes: Label what the student actually did, not what the reference solution does.
